subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs accept provider/model overrides via `payload.model`, top-level cron fields, or an explicit `sessionOverride` block, and what should invalid-model and fallback behavior be?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API shape affects cron protocol compatibility, session state, provider/auth routing, fallback semantics, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Add explicit sessionOverride contract
options.body: Introduce a typed cron `sessionOverride` block for provider/model with explicit validation, docs, and regression coverage for `wakeMode: "now"` and next-heartbeat execution.

options.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
options.body: Reuse the existing `payload.model` shape for `systemEvent` if maintainers prefer parity with `agentTurn`, but wire it through a direct model propagation path rather than encoded context state.

options.title: Keep overrides unsupported
options.body: Document dedicated session keys plus session model selection as the supported workaround and leave job-level main-systemEvent overrides out of cron for now.

recommendation.title: Add explicit sessionOverride contract
recommendation.body: Introduce a typed cron `sessionOverride` block for provider/model with explicit validation, docs, and regression coverage for `wakeMode: "now"` and next-heartbeat execution.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cron runtime/product context and merged the adjacent UI model-selection PR that deliberately left this runtime surface open.
